comparison_policy: Only same-10-case executable outputs are scored; paper numbers are not substituted.

methods.implementation: Shared OpenAI-compatible Alibaba Cloud Model Studio adapter
methods.notes: Uses the same frozen Qwen 3.7 Plus configuration as CADIR/SimpleCAD; the local credential file is Git-ignored.
Pinned source installed in the paper .venv; OCP solid creation plus STEP/STL export passed a local smoke test. It shares the exact Qwen 3.7 Plus client configuration used by the direct baseline.
The project describes multimodal input and URDF export, but the visible Code link did not resolve to a runnable repository during this audit.
The arXiv record and paper describe the method, but no official runnable repository was verified during this audit.
